description:
Analyze one window of vibration samples you supply: RMS, crest factor, kurtosis, order
        harmonics, residual against a model, alarms and possible fault hypotheses (not diagnoses).
        Never reads a live sensor.
        Example: analyze_vibration_samples(samples=[0.01, 0.42, -0.38, ...], sample_rate_hz=1024, shaft_rpm=1800).

alarm_crest.description: Crest factor that counts as an alarm.
alarm_crest.title: Alarm Crest

alarm_residual.description: Residual against the model that counts as an alarm.
alarm_residual.title: Alarm Residual

alarm_rms.description: RMS level that counts as an alarm.
alarm_rms.title: Alarm Rms

model.description: Optional expected samples (same length) to compute the residual against.
model.title: Model

quality.description: Quality of the samples: good, uncertain or bad.
quality.title: Quality

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of the samples, in Hz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

samples.description: One window of vibration samples (numbers), supplied by you.
samples.title: Samples

shaft_rpm.description: Shaft speed in revolutions per minute.
shaft_rpm.title: Shaft Rpm

name: analyze_vibration_samples
title: Analyze vibration samples
